shist test · your shell history, with dates

USAGE
  shist [flags]

FILTER
  -g, -grep PATTERN       commands matching a regex
  -C, -context N          also show N commands either side of each match
  -B, -before N           …only before
  -A, -after N            …only after
  -n N                    only the newest N matches
  -min-date DATE          on or after DATE
  -max-date DATE          on or before DATE (a bare date is the whole day)
  -min-index N            index >= N
  -max-index N            index <= N

OUTPUT
  -format TEMPLATE        e.g. '%d %c' · see shist -h format
  -date-format LAYOUT     Go layout for %d (default "2006-01-02 15:04")
  -c, -concat-multiline   multi-line commands on one line
  -no-color               no colour

OTHER
  -file PATH              read this history file (default: your shell's)
  -v, -version            print the version
  -h, -help [TOPIC]       this help · topics: format, env

EXAMPLES
  shist -g docker -n 20                 # newest 20 docker commands
  shist -g 'git push' -C 3              # each push, 3 commands either side
  shist -min-date 2025-04-01 -format '%c' | fzf

DATE is YYYY-MM-DD, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" or UNIX seconds. -n and --n both work.
